text: {"lessons":["A decade of periods without trading has still produced a positive account-value trend, so I should not assume frequent trading is necessary.","The gains so far do not prove that any one holding or strategy is safe; I should continue to pay attention to diversification and risk.","Given my infrequent reviews, I should set a thoughtful long-term plan and make changes only when my goals, allocation, or the reasons for holding a stock materially change."]}
